headline: Mexican peso posts moderate decline against the dollar on improved market sentiment
summary: The peso posted a moderate decline against the dollar, despite a stronger US currency. Traders were digesting data on Mexico's economic growth.
why: The peso is the Mexican currency, and its moves reflect shifts in global risk sentiment and domestic growth data.
original_headline: Peso mexicano registra moderada caída frente al dólar ante un mejor sentimiento en el mercado
